summary: Trivial forwarder: returns the result of BooleanToIntConversion applied to the address of the PhysicsShutdown handler global. Named and shaped like an atexit-style registration stub that folds a handler pointer/flag condition into an integer.

operations.description: Call BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) with the address of the PhysicsShutdown global (0x00431C70) as its single argument.
Return the integer produced by the BooleanToIntConversion call.

unresolved: Semantics of BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) are unknown here; the name suggests it folds a boolean/pointer condition into an integer.
Any registration side-effect implied by the legacy ABI name Atexit_Handler_Registration (e.g. atexit hookup of PhysicsShutdown) is not visible in this function body.
